title: Proposed Sixth Prohibition: Transformation of Potentially Habitable Worlds Before Survey
summary: Would have added a general prohibition on irreversible transformation of potentially habitable worlds before a published survey. Won a large majority but fell short of the ninety-per-cent threshold for new prohibitions.

provisions.heading: Prohibition
provisions.text: The following is added to the prohibitions of the Interim Charter: '6. Irreversible transformation of a potentially habitable world before a survey of that world has been published.'

provisions.heading: Scope
provisions.text: The prohibition applies to all claims, including those released after the Treaty, and is enforced by the Arbiter and Tribunal in the same manner as the existing prohibitions.

history.action: Filed as a proposed prohibition (ninety per cent of seats voting required).
Not carried: 420 in favour against a requirement of 508 (90% of 564 seats voting).
